notes: Account summary: large regulated fintech startup building enterprise search + analyst assistant across internal legal, compliance, and customer support corpora.
Primary need: high-quality retrieval + reranking pipeline. Bi-encoder for fast recall, cross-encoder reranker for final ranking on top-K (K=20).

Indexing scale: targeting 300M documents (approx 450M vectors with multi-vector per doc for chunking & embeddings), 1536-dim embeddings baseline, interested in 768/1024 experiments for cost tradeoffs.

Query profile: baseline 50 QPS, peak 250 QPS during business hours; concurrency spikes up to 600 QPS for batch workflows. Target retrieval latency <= 150ms (ANN) and end-to-end re-rank latency <= 750ms for interactive UX.
Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per query (retrieval + rerank) < $0.002–0.003; want Redwood Optimize recommendations to reach <$0.0015 if possible.

Vector DB preferences: prefer pgvector for on-prem/private install, Pinecone for hosted evaluation, Weaviate considered for hybrid BM25+ANN. Elastic evaluated for existing text search tie-in but vector scaling concerns noted.

Connector requirements (explicit): upsert throughput >= 10k/sec, bulk ingest ability 100M/day (initial backfill), real-time CDC from Postgres, namespace/multi-tenant isolation, per-vector metadata filters, complex boolean filtering, field-level ACLs, snapshot/restore and export in Arrow/NPZ, model-agnostic embedding storage (support float32/float16/quantized formats).

Operational needs: per-query cost breakdown, token-level observability for reranker, tracing from query -> retrieval -> rerank, alerting for drift and quality regressions, retention controls and audit logs for compliance.

Security: must support customer-managed KMS/HSM for keys, SSO/SAML with SCIM provisioning, SOC2 + ISO27001 required for production, data residency in us-east and eu-west regions, legal to sign standard DPA with annex for financial data.

POC goals: demonstrate 95th percentile retrieval lat < 200ms at 250 QPS for 300M vectors on Dedicated plan; show rerank CPU/GPU cost and latency tradeoffs across quantization & batching strategies; validate connector for incremental upserts from transactional DB.
Quote from lead ML eng: 'We need retrieval that feels instant for traders. If the reranker kills the UX we lose adoption.'

Internal notes: explore model offloading for rerank (dedicated small GPU pool) vs CPU cross-encoder with distillation. Redwood Optimize expected to run batching & quantization scenarios and output cost/latency tradeoffs.
Procurement timeline: legal review ongoing, budget penciled for Q2 2026. If POC meets SLOs, plan to convert to Dedicated + Private (VPC) for production.
Key stakeholders: CTO (platform), Head of Search (evaluation owner), ML infra lead (integration), Security/compliance counsel.

Ask for Redwood SE: prepare connector test harness (pgvector + Pinecone), sample ingestion scripts, expected cost model for 300M vectors, recommended quantization profiles and fallback model variants for graceful degradation.
